rules.sentence: CE MRI is the best imaging modality as it clearly demonstrates bone edema with a contrast enhancement on fat-suppressed CE-T1-WI, associated with a paraspinal inflammatory infiltrate.
In the setting of tubercular spondylitis, bone sclerosis can be seen (providing an ivory vertebra, generally at multiple levels) due to the reactive inflammation surrounding the infection.

Despite their efficacy, these techniques are costly and limited in availability, and currently, the Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA) guidelines recommend the use of 18F-FDG-PET/CT only in cases where an MRI is contraindicated.
